tagline: Close it mid-essay and you are still on that chapter. Send the invite and a friend watches the same tournament.
description:
This copy keeps your place inside the file, works with no connection, and one invite puts a friend in the same tournament you are running — they see the same winners, the same mistakes, the same mix of characters and payoffs.

On your own it is Nicky Case's explorable: the Game of Trust, one round then many, a round-robin, then evolution, noise, and a pond you stock with copycats, cheaters, grudgers and the rest. About half an hour. Tap the dots along the bottom to jump chapters.

On a phone the whole stage shrinks to fit. Back steps one chapter. Sound is the speaker in the corner. Footnotes open from the credits, in here, not a second page.

An unofficial port of The Evolution of Trust by Nicky Case, dedicated to the public domain.
